description.ja: ●西域出身の機駕の武将だったが司馬懿のやり方に疑問を持ち、翔へと向かった。 ●武将モードから謎の軍師形態へ変形。各種武器が付属。 ●鎧や背中のエフェクトパーツは台座で展示可能。 成型品×3、シール×1、組立説明書（マンガ有り）
description.en: -He was a military commander from the Western region, but he had doubts about Sima Yi's methods and headed to Xiang. -Transforms from military commander mode to mysterious tactician form. Various weapons are included. -Effect parts on the armor and back can be displayed on the pedestal. Molded product x 3, Seal x 1, Assembly manual (with manga)
